text:
Nick Perbix is a sixth-round pick from Elk River, Minnesota, who played for the U.S. at the 2022 Olympics and won a role in Tampa Bay before coming to Nashville. He's a right-shot defenseman playing 18.5 minutes a night, and lately the Predators have been winning with him on the ice.

He has two goals and four points in 18 games, both goals in the last two weeks: his first on Nov. 3 against Carolina, then an empty-netter against St. Louis. He has blocked 32 shots and thrown just three hits, which tells you the kind of defender he is: positional, not physical.

The underlying numbers urge caution. Nashville has had 44.1% of expected goals at five on five with him on, a bit worse than without him, and his comparables share one trait: chances against pile up. Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level in 2025-26. Our range has him finishing around 17 points. What to watch is whether his pair can keep chances down as Nashville's winning run is tested.
headline: Perbix has found some scoring in Nashville
